newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank branch boosts international settlements.
newsitem.headline: China bank branch boosts international settlements.

text.p: The Shanghai branch of the China Construction Bank, a major state-owned commercial bank, boosted its international settlements business to a record level in the first half of 1997, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.
The bank's international settlements business reached $1.87 billion in the first six months, up nearly 38 percent from the same period last year, the agency said.
Both the total amount and the increase were a record for the bank branch, it said, quoting a Construction Bank official.
The official attributed the rise to an increase in foreign exchange business and import settlements as well as an overall effort to attract more customers.
